newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris air cargo steering group launches publication.
newsitem.headline: Paris air cargo steering group launches publication.

text.p: The Comite Interprofessionel du Fret (CIF), a steering group set up by the air cargo community at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, has launched its own English-language publication.
CIF's executve committee comprises representatives from France's air freight forwarding agents, SNAGFA, airlines, customs and the Paris airport authority's freight marketing department.

The 20 page first edition of the publication, called, "Paris Air Cargo Times" (PACT) deals with current issues in the sector including airport policy, freight handling developments, customs, technology and multimedia as well as a feature on Federal Express major hub project at CDG.

CIF chairman Klaus Pfab said PACT would not only have an informing role on air cargo developments at the Paris airports but would also serve as a vehicle for feedback from customers both in France and abroad.

"We look forward to receiving comments and suggestions from customers which will allow us to improve services further. On behalf of all our partners in the cargo chain we hope PACT will constitute a powerful link and prove a useful tool for our mutual success," Pfab said.
The CIF expects to publish PACT two or three times a year with the next edition scheduled for June 1997.
Copies of PACT are available on request from Tel +33 1 48 62 60. 78
